method: Manual border-vertex digitization of original raster figure; log-P interpolation; NOT author-supplied numerical data.
density_convention: fixed reference n0=0.16 fm^-3, not the varying model saturation density
digitization_tolerance: Approximately 3 image pixels (about 3 percent pressure); use for exploratory tuning only.
loss_definition: 10 * density-average of squared distance outside log-pressure band divided by log-band halfwidth; zero inside. Not chi-square.
